title: 为什么 lmkd 会杀看似优先级更高的进程：证据链与误判拆解
key_conclusions: A high-priority kill claim must align pressure, priority, and source-bucket evidence at the kill timestamp.
The oom_score_adj value at kill time is more important than screenshots or post-restart process state.
A victim can be correctly selected even when a different producer caused slab, dma-buf, file-cache, or memcg pressure.
Fixes differ sharply between adj bugs, expected cached kills, victim-owned memory, shared producers, and aggressive tuning.
shallow_points: The article does not include a real lmkd kill incident with timestamped logs and statsd records.
It does not validate exact lmkd log fields across Android releases and vendor builds.
It does not provide a runnable sampler for kill-window adj and PSI timelines.
It does not quantify how much RSS must be freed to make a victim choice effective.
